title: Jimmie Lunceford as a person
summary: Lunceford was quiet, did not drink or curse, was strict about uniforms and punctuality with fines, and was like a school teacher.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: I liked him. He was quiet, very

reserved. He didn't drink. He didn't smoke. I worked with Lunceford about three, four years. I never heard him say damn, you know. He was very reserved. He didn't like for any of the guys to drink or anything. We all drank, but he didn't particularly care for it, you know.
He was very strict, and he was very well organized. I could say that about the guy. He was -- he knew what he wanted. He went after it in the right way.
Well, you had to have the right uniforms, and he was worried about your dress, how you was dressed and being prompt, you know, making time, and he was very strict in a sense like that for rehearsals.
If somebody didn't what would happen?

They would be fined. And I guess if you did it too much, which didn't happen with us, he'd probably make a change, you know. But it -- that didn't get that far. Things didn't get that far because he had a nice bunch of guys that -- they were regular guys, though. They weren't -- they weren't too, too reserved. They did a few things, you know, so --
-- you know, but he was -- he was more of a school teacher type person, and that's what he did before -- before he organized, got that band.
